posts.title: The Weight of Silence
posts.excerpt: Sometimes the heaviest things we carry are the words we never speak. Silence isn't always peace; sometimes it's a war...
posts.content: Sometimes the heaviest things we carry are the words we never speak. Silence isn't always peace; sometimes it's a war we fight within ourselves. In this piece, I explore the burden of unexpressed emotions and the courage it takes to break the silence.
posts.author: PaGidi

posts.title: Healing is a Journey
posts.excerpt: You don't just wake up one day and everything is fine. Healing is messy, it's non-linear, and it requires patience...
posts.content: You don't just wake up one day and everything is fine. Healing is messy, it's non-linear, and it requires patience. This expression delves into the reality of the healing process and why we need to be gentle with ourselves along the way.
posts.author: PaGidi

posts.title: To The Broken Hearted
posts.excerpt: It's okay to feel. It's okay to cry. Your emotions are valid, and your pain is real. Let it out, then let it go...
posts.content: It's okay to feel. It's okay to cry. Your emotions are valid, and your pain is real. Let it out, then let it go. This piece is a gentle reminder that experiencing pain is part of being human, and there's no shame in expressing it.
posts.author: PaGidi
